name: H. G. Wells
summary: Wells described himself as a Socialist, favouring gradual, administered public ownership of land and main services, heavy death duties and graduated taxes, and a state that guarantees work. His consistent aim was a federal world state or league with real authority above nations, ending armaments and secret diplomacy, and in 1940 he drafted a universal declaration of human rights. He also wrote early eugenic and race-efficiency proposals and favoured rule by a voluntary, trained elite.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The Utopian state shelters and "strengthens" any citizen who is ill, which supports public provision of health care without stating a full universal scheme.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Wells wanted competition kept for fame, service and position but not for getting property, and said the New Republic would hold "no superstition of laissez faire".

public-ownership.rationale: The constructive Socialist works to transfer the main public services steadily from private enterprise to municipal and State control, and in Utopia the roads, railways and energy sources are public.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: He proposed death duties and heavy graduated taxes on irresponsible incomes as a main means of controlling great unearned fortunes.

unions-good.rationale: He praised no union as such: Anticipations calls the trade-union spirit a conservative contagion of old craftsmanship, while Utopia lets no union limit a worker, and his socialist writing treats them as part of labour representation.

property-fundamental.rationale: Wells wrote that absolute property hardly exists and proposed gradual abolition of the great bulk of private ownership, with land resumed by the community by taxation, purchase and partly compensated confiscation.

regulate-corporations.rationale: The New Republic would attack irresponsible property and speculation and treat credit as a human contrivance open to control, rather than leave business unregulated.

cut-welfare.rationale: Utopia keeps the state as reserve employer, pays pensions and shelters the derelict and sick, and Wells wrote nothing about welfare creating dependency.
